newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Lek considers listing abroad.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Lek considers listing abroad.

text.p: Slovenian pharmaceutical company Lek said on Thursday it was considering listing its shares abroad.
"We are considering this possibility, but there is no decision yet concerning the matter," Jadranka Dakic, a member of the management team at Lek, told a news conference.

Lek general manager Mojmir Urlep added that if the company decided to float its shares abroad, it would be to increase its share price, which he said was undervalued, and not because it needed additional capital.
So far bank SKB and warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC are the only two Slovenian companies that have been listed abroad.
